name: 592. Model and video calls that name their target follow request_path_overrides on the other bases, and gemini and kling refuse their video ones (resource path overrides) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-7096 regression. Local fixture regression, no live provider calls: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream. Every row is skipped otherwise. Before TXE-7096 only the openai base read request_path_overrides on model and video calls: the other bases sent their vendors' own paths, or the override with its placeholder still in it. tkp_ovr_anthropic and tkp_ovr_gemini move model_retrieve to /moved/model_retrieve/{model}, and tkp_ovr_moved_volcengine moves video_retrieve, video_download and video_delete to /moved/<request type>/{video_id}. The fixture answers only those paths, for om-7096 and cgt-ovr-video. Each of 592.1 to 592.5 resets the fixture, makes one call, and reads GET /__wire: exactly one call reached the moved path with the id in place and the provider's own key. 592.6 and 592.7 write a gemini-based provider with a video_retrieve override and a kling-based one with a video_download override: each is a 400 naming the override, the base and the reason, and nothing is stored. A gemini video id names an operation or an Interactions task, two APIs with different paths, and Kling queries a task by a query parameter on one fixed path, so neither has a path for a template to place the id in.

item.name: 592.6 [EXPECT-400] POST /api/providers: a gemini-based provider with a video_retrieve override is refused when it is written (resource path overrides)

exec: pm.test('the provider is refused with a 400 naming the override, the base and the reason', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include('request_path_overrides.video_retrieve is not supported on the gemini base');

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/api/providers/harness-gemini-video-path-override', method: 'GET' }, function (err, res) { pm.test('nothing was stored', function () { pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(res.code, res.text()).to.equal(404); }); });
